Config.description:
Settings that apply to every request in the collection. A request's own setting wins over
the one here, and `ignore_config` turns one off for a single request.

auth.description:
Authorization shorthand for every request: "bearer <token>" or "basic <user>:<pass>",
e.g. "bearer {{token}}".

expect_max_ms.description: Fail a request that takes longer than this many milliseconds.

ignore_ssl.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Only for test servers with self-signed certificates.

order.description:
The requests to run, in this order. A request can be listed more than once, and requests
that aren't listed don't run. Without it, every request runs in file order. Naming a
request on the command line runs only that request.

retry.description: Retry a failed request this many more times. `retry = 3` means up to 4 attempts.

retry_delay_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait between retries. Defaults to 1000.

use_custom_ca.description:
Path to a CA bundle (PEM, JKS, or PKCS12) to trust, relative to the collection file.
The keystore password comes from `--use-custom-ca-password` or `TOAD_CA_PASSWORD`.

RequestDef.description:
One request. Every top-level table other than `[config]`, `[vars]`, and `[profiles]` is a
request, and the table name is the request name.

auth.description:
Authorization shorthand: "bearer <token>" or "basic <user>:<pass>", e.g.
"bearer {{token}}". Overrides `auth` in `[config]`.

body.description: Request body. Use either `body` or `body_file`, not both.

body_file.description: Path to a file to send as the request body, relative to the collection file.

capture.description:
Values to read from the response into variables for later requests. Each value is a
JSONPath query starting with "$", "header:<Name>", "status", or "body".

expect_max_ms.description:
Fail the request if it takes longer than this many milliseconds. Overrides
`expect_max_ms` in `[config]`.

expect_status.description: Status codes that count as a pass. Without it, any response passes.

ignore_config.description: `[config]` settings to ignore for this request.

interpolate_body.description: When false, `body`/`body_file` is sent exactly as written, without `{{var}}` interpolation

query.description: Query string parameters, added to the URL.

retry.description: Retry the request this many more times if it fails. Overrides `retry` in `[config]`.

retry_delay_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait between retries. Overrides `retry_delay_ms` in `[config]`.

timeout_secs.description: Seconds to wait for a response before giving up. Defaults to 30.

url.description: URL to send the request to, e.g. "{{base_url}}/users/1".

description: A toad collection file. See https://github.com/benabernathy/toad-cli

profiles.description: Named sets of variables, chosen with --profile. A profile's values replace the ones in [vars].
